column1: # registry/endpoint-consumers.tsv — endpoint-consumers cross-lane registry (kama-shokunin)
# Tab-separated, 6 columns; '#' comments and blank lines ignored; the 'id' header row is
# skipped. Rows must be consumers that are LIVE or LOADABLE — pure file fossils
# (e.g. ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json.*.bak) are inventoried in the census instead of
# being reconciled here, so drift counts keep meaning "an endpoint in service is wrong".
#   id <TAB> consumer_path <TAB> json_pointer_or_grep <TAB> declared_baseurl <TAB> expected_model_id <TAB> notes
# id                 stable row key, echoed in probe output.
# consumer_path      file that pins (or defaults) the endpoint: config, systemd unit, script,
#                    or binary default. '~' expands to $HOME; relative paths resolve against
#                    the repo root. The probe only ever reads it.
# json_pointer_or_grep
#                    how the probe re-derives the declared baseURL FROM THE FILE ITSELF
#                    (declared_baseurl is the registry's claim, never the source of truth):
#                      json:<RFC6901 pointer>  exact drill-down (python3; leaf-key grep fallback)
#                      grep:<ERE>              first match wins. A match containing a URL is
#                                              used verbatim; a match containing an EXPLICIT port
#                                              marker (port=NNNN, --port NNNN, host:NNNN) is
#                                              synthesised to http://127.0.0.1:<port>/v1;
#                                              anything else marks the row file_match=inherited
#                                              (the baseURL comes from the named provider).
#                    A bare digit run is never read as a port — "Qwen3-Coder-30B" is not port 30.
# declared_baseurl   the endpoint the registry believes this consumer targets.
# expected_model_id  model id this consumer believes it is talking to; '*' or '-' = any.
# notes              provenance / risk class. Free text, no tabs.
# Verdicts come from tools/kama-probe.sh:
#   MODEL_OK | MODEL_MISMATCH | FOREIGN_SERVICE | UNAUTHORIZED_SERVICE | DEAD | NOT_HTTP
# Evidence: path:line of the pin + probe command output.
